data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $75,625,000 (2021: $60,654,000) is a deterioration of $10,434,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2021: deterioration $5,306,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of $10.434 million in prior year claims reserves, primarily affecting the 2020 and prior years of account. This deterioration was attributed to additional information from pricing current and prospective business, a loading for inflation, and adjustments to the reserving approach, including actuarial best estimates and confidence margins.
raw_causal_phrases: back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account on a stand-alone basis
assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business
a loading for inflation and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates, has contributed to the back year deterioration
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of $10.434m is stated as 'included within net calendar year claims incurred', indicating it is a net figure (after reinsurance). No gross prior year development figure was explicitly available. The gross claims development triangle on page 22 was deemed unreliable for calculating prior year development due to the mention of Reinsurance to Close (RITC) for the 2020 year of account on page 36, which can distort the underlying claims development.
